prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” interior painting company for everyone — the right choice depends on your budget, schedule, home size/age, and the level of finish you want. That said, St. Louis has several well-regarded options (national franchises with local branches and independent shops). If you want to start your search quickly, consider:

- CertaPro Painters (St. Louis area franchise) — a common choice for consistent estimates, insured crews and warranties.
- Five Star Painting (local franchise) — known for quick turnarounds and transparent quotes.
- Fresh Coat Painters (St. Louis franchise) — often used for both residential and commercial interior jobs.

Those are examples of established franchises that tend to be easy to vet. There are also many highly rated independent St. Louis painters who may offer more personalized service and competitive pricing — you’ll find them on Google Reviews, Angi, Yelp, and the BBB.

How to choose the best company for you
- Read recent reviews and look at photos of finished interior jobs.
- Ask for at least 3 written estimates that show prep work, number of coats, paint brand, and total price.
- Verify insurance, licensing (if required for the job), and ask for references from previous customers.
- Confirm the paint brands they use (Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, etc.) and whether primer is included.
- Ask about prep and protection (patching, sanding, caulking, floor/trim protection) and cleanup.
- Get a written warranty or guarantee on workmanship and touch-up policies.
- For older homes, ask about lead-safe practices and certification if lead paint is a concern.

Questions to ask during the estimate
- What is included in the scope of work (prep, number of coats, doors/trim)?
- Which paint brand/product will you use and is it included?
- How do you protect furniture/floors and clean up?
- Do you provide a written contract and warranty?
- Can you provide references or recent project photos?

Typical cost expectations (ballpark)
- Small bedroom: $300–$900
- Average living room or larger room: $500–$1,500
- Whole-house interior (2–4 bedrooms): $2,000–$10,000+ depending on size and prep needed

If you’d like, tell me:
- your zip code,
- how many rooms or square feet,
- any special needs (high ceilings, textured walls, wallpaper removal, trim work),
and I can suggest more specific local companies or draft a message you can send to painters to request estimates.
